theorems.name: Submission.frt_vgm_tba_ball_cutoff_sandwich
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)) (κ t : ℝ), 0 < κ → κ < 1 → 0 < t → closedBall x (2 * t) ⊆ U → (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → (∫ z, max 0 (min 1 ((1 - ‖t⁻¹ • (z.1 - x)‖) / κ)) * β z.2 ∂V.measure) ≤ ∫ z in closedBall x t ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure ∧ ∫ z in closedBall x t ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure ≤ ∫ z, max 0 (min 1 ((1 + κ - ‖t⁻¹ • (z.1 - x)‖) / κ)) * β z.2 ∂V.measure
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
